   <ix:exclude>&#160;</ix:exclude>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><i></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31" name="lvo:ConvertibleDebtDerivativeTreatmentPolicyTextBlock" id="c113578444" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Convertible Debt </span></i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">&#8211;</span><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; "> Derivative Treatment</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">When the Company issues debt with a conversion feature, we must <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> assess whether the conversion feature meets the requirements to be treated as a derivative, as follows: (a) <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> or more underlyings, typically the price of our common stock; (b) <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> or more notional amounts or payment provisions or both, generally the number of shares upon conversion; (c) <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> initial net investment, which typically excludes the amount borrowed; and (d) net settlement provisions, which in the case of convertible debt generally means the stock received upon conversion can be readily sold for cash. An embedded equity-linked component that meets the definition of a derivative does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have to be separated from the host instrument if the component qualifies for the scope exception for certain contracts involving an issuer&#8217;s own equity. The scope exception applies if the contract is both (a) indexed to its own stock; and (b) classified in stockholders&#8217; equity in its balance sheet.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">If the conversion feature within convertible debt meets the requirements to be treated as a derivative, we estimate the fair value of the convertible debt derivative using the appropriate valuation model upon the date of issuance. If the fair value of the convertible debt derivative is higher than the face value of the convertible debt, the excess is immediately recognized as interest expense. Otherwise, the fair value of the convertible debt derivative is recorded as a liability with an offsetting amount recorded as a debt discount, which offsets the carrying amount of the debt. The convertible debt derivative is revalued at the end of each reporting period and any change in fair value is recorded as a gain or loss in the statement of operations. The debt discount is amortized through interest expense over the life of the debt.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><i></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31" name="lvo:DebtModificationsAndExtinguishmentsPolicyTextBlock" id="c113578445" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Debt Modifications and Extinguishments</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">When the Company modifies or extinguishes debt, it <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> evaluates whether the modification qualifies as a troubled debt restructuring (TDR) under ASC Topic <em style="font: inherit;">470</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">60,</em> which requires debt modifications to be evaluated if (<em style="font: inherit;">1</em>) the borrower is experiencing financial difficulty, and (<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) the lender grants the borrower a concession. If a TDR is determined <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> to have occurred, the Company evaluates the modification in accordance with ASC Topic <em style="font: inherit;">470</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">50</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">40,</em> which requires modification to debt instruments to be evaluated to assess whether the modifications are considered &#8220;substantial modifications&#8221;. A substantial modification of terms is accounted for like an extinguishment.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">If there is a conversion feature within the debt instrument, the Company evaluates whether the conversion feature should be bifurcated under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815</em> as a derivative. If the Company believes the embedded conversion feature has <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> fair value on the date of issuance (measurement date) and the embedded conversion feature has <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> beneficial conversion feature, the embedded conversion feature does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> meet the criteria in ASC <em style="font: inherit;">470</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">50</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">40</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">10</em> or <em style="font: inherit;">470</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">20</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">25</em> and the issuance of the convertible debt is considered a modification, and <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> an extinguishment that would require the recognition of a gain or loss. If the Company determines the change in fair value of the derivative meets the criteria for substantial modification under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">470</em> it will treat the modification as extinguishment and recognize a loss from debt extinguishment.</p>
   <p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskCreditRisk" id="c113578446" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Concentration of Credit Risk</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company maintains cash balances at commercial banks. Cash balances commonly exceed the <em style="font: inherit;">$250,000</em> amount insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation. The Company has <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> experienced any losses in such accounts, and management believes that the Company is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> exposed to any significant credit risk with respect to such cash and cash equivalents.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31" name="lvo:SeasonalityPolicyTextBlock" id="c113578447" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Seasonality</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Our CPS merchandising business is affected by seasonality, which typically results in higher sales volume during our <em style="font: inherit;">third</em> quarter, which ends <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>

       <a href="#toc" style="font-weight: initial; font-style: initial; font-variant: initial; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Table of Contents</a>

   <ix:exclude>&#160;</ix:exclude>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="c113578448" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Recently Issued Accounting Pronouncements</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 27pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> November 2023, </em>the FASB issued ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">07,</em> Segment Reporting (Topic <em style="font: inherit;">280</em>): Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures to update reportable segment disclosure requirements, primarily through enhanced disclosures about significant segment expenses and information used to assess segment performance. This update is effective beginning with the Company&#8217;s <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em> fiscal year annual reporting period, with early adoption permitted. The Company is currently assessing the impact this standard will have on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 27pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 27pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> December 2023, </em>the FASB issued ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09,</em>&#160;Income Taxes (Topic <em style="font: inherit;">740</em>): Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures&#160;(&#8220;ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09&#8221;</em>), which will require the Company to disclose specified additional information in its income tax rate reconciliation and provide additional information for reconciling items that meet a quantitative threshold. ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09</em> will also require the Company to disaggregate its income taxes paid disclosure by federal, state and foreign taxes, with further disaggregation required for significant individual jurisdictions. The Company will adopt ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09</em> beginning in the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> quarter of <em style="font: inherit;">2026.</em> ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">09</em> allows for adoption using either a prospective or retrospective transition method.&#160;The Company is currently assessing the impact this standard will have on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 27pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: -9pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Recently Adopted Accounting Pronouncements</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> October 2021, </em>the FASB issued ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2021</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">08,</em> Business Combinations (Topic <em style="font: inherit;">805</em>), Accounting for Contract Assets and Contract Liabilities from Contracts with Customers. ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2021</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">08</em> requires the recognition and measurement of contract assets and contract liabilities acquired in a business combination in accordance with ASC <em style="font: inherit;">606,</em> Revenue from Contracts with Customers. Considerations to determine the amount of contract assets and contract liabilities to record at the acquisition date include the terms of the acquired contract, such as timing of payment, identification of each performance obligation in the contract and allocation of the contract transaction price to each identified performance obligation on a relative standalone selling price basis as of contract inception. ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2021</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">08</em> is effective for the Company beginning in the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> quarter of <em style="font: inherit;">2023.</em> ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2021</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">08</em> should be applied prospectively for acquisitions occurring on or after the effective date of the amendments. Early adoption of the proposed amendments would be permitted, including adoption in an interim period. The adoption of this standard did <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have an impact on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> June 2016, </em>the FASB issued ASU <em style="font: inherit;">No.</em> <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">13,</em> Financial Instruments-Credit Losses (Topic <em style="font: inherit;">326</em>): Measurement of Credit Losses on Financial Instruments, which requires the measurement and recognition of expected credit losses for financial assets held at amortized cost. It also eliminates the concept of other-than-temporary impairment and requires credit losses related to available-for-sale debt securities to be recorded through an allowance for credit losses rather than as a reduction in the amortized cost basis of the securities. These changes will result in more timely recognition of credit losses. The guidance is effective for fiscal years beginning after <em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2022 </em>for SEC filers that are eligible to be smaller reporting companies under the SEC&#8217;s definition, and interim periods within those fiscal years.&#160;The Company adopted ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">13</em> on <em style="font: inherit;"> April 1, 2023&#160;</em>on a prospective basis. The adoption of this standard did <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have an impact on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">For some contracts, the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>invoice up front for services recognized over time or for contracts in which the Company has unsatisfied performance obligations. Payment terms and conditions vary by contract type, although terms generally cover monthly payments. In the circumstances where the timing of invoicing differs from the timing of revenue recognition, the Company has determined its contracts do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> include a significant financing component. The Company has elected to apply the practical expedient under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">606</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">10</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">50</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">14</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> provide disclosure of the amount and timing of performance obligations as the performance obligations are part of a contract that has an original expected duration of <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> year or less.&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">For the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113574976"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113574981">one</span></span> customer accounted for <ix:nonFraction id="c113574977" contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-OneCustomerMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">51</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction id="c113574978" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2023-03-31_ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis-SalesRevenueNetMember_ConcentrationRiskByTypeAxis-CustomerConcentrationRiskMember_MajorCustomersAxis-OneCustomerMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskPercentage1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">44</ix:nonFraction>% of our consolidated revenues, respectively.</p>

The estimated useful lives for patents, content creator relationships, domain names, tradename and customer list&#160;are generally <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575087">three</span> to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575088">15</span>&#160;years, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575089">one</span> to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575090">two</span>&#160;years, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575091">two</span> to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575092">five</span> years, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575093">seven</span> to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575094">ten</span> years&#160;and <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575095">three</span> to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575096">four</span> years, respectively.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> June 17, 2020, </em>the Company received the proceeds from a loan in the amount of less than $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575217" contextRef="d_2020-06-17_2020-06-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-SbaLoanMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromNotesPayable" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.2</ix:nonFraction> million from the United States&#160;Small Business Administration (the &#8220;SBA&#8221;). Installment payments, including principal and interest, begin <em style="font: inherit;">12</em>-months from the date of the promissory note. The balance is payable <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2020-06-17_2020-06-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-SbaLoanMember" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentTerm" id="c113575219" format="ixt-sec:duryear">30</ix:nonNumeric>-years from the date of the promissory note, and bears interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c113575220" contextRef="i_2020-06-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-SbaLoanMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">3.75</ix:nonFraction>% per annum. The are <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> covenants associated with the SBA loan.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: -9pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Loan and Security Agreement</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> August 2023, </em>the Company entered into a Loan and Security Agreement with Capchase Inc. (&#8220;Capchase&#8221;) pursuant to which the Company borrowed&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c113575222" contextRef="i_2023-08-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-CapchaseMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SubordinatedDebtMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.7</ix:nonFraction> million to further develop and acquire certain podcasts acquired by PodcastOne and for general working capital. The debt is subordinated to the ABL Credit Facility (as defined below) and bears an interest rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c113575223" contextRef="i_2023-08-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-CapchaseMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SubordinatedDebtMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">9</ix:nonFraction>%, which is included in the monthly amortization payments of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575224" contextRef="d_2023-08-01_2023-08-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-CapchaseMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SubordinatedDebtMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">73,100</ix:nonFraction>, with the final amortization payment due on <em style="font: inherit;"> February 4, 2026.</em></p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">9</em> </b>&#8212;<b> PodcastOne Bridge Loan</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">PodcastOne</span></i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">&#8217;</span><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">s Private Placement</span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> July 15, 2022 (</em>the &#8220;Closing Date&#8221;), PodcastOne completed a private placement offering (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;PC1</em> Bridge Loan&#8221;) of PodcastOne&#8217;s unsecured convertible notes with an original issue discount of <ix:nonFraction id="c113575250" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentDiscountPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">10</ix:nonFraction>% (the &#8220;OID&#8221;) in the aggregate principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575251" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">8.8</ix:nonFraction> million (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;PC1</em> Notes&#8221;) to certain accredited investors and institutional investors (collectively, the &#8220;Purchasers&#8221;), for gross proceeds of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575253" contextRef="d_2022-07-15_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">8.0</ix:nonFraction> million pursuant to the Subscription Agreements entered into with the Purchasers (the &#8220;Subscription Agreements&#8221;). In connection with the sale of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes, the Purchasers received warrants (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;PC1</em> Warrants&#8221;) to purchase a number of shares (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;PC1</em> Warrant Shares&#8221;) of PodcastOne&#8217;s common stock, par value $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575257" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_LegalEntityAxis-PodcastoneMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">0.00001</ix:nonFraction> per share. The <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes mature <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575259">one</span> year from the Closing Date, subject to a <em style="font: inherit;">one</em>-time <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>-month extension at PodcastOne&#8217;s election (the &#8220;Maturity Date&#8221;). The <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes bear interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c113575263" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">10</ix:nonFraction>% per annum payable on maturity. The <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes would&#160;automatically convert into the securities of PodcastOne sold in a Qualified Financing (an initial public offering of PodcastOne&#8217;s securities from which PodcastOne&#8217;s trading market at the closing of such offering is a national securities exchange) or Qualified Event (a direct listing of PodcastOne&#8217;s securities on a national securities exchange), as applicable, upon the closing of a Qualified Financing or Qualified Event, as applicable, at a price per share equal to the lesser of (i) the price equal to $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575265" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleCarryingAmountOfTheEquityComponent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">60.0</ix:nonFraction> million divided by the aggregate number of shares of PodcastOne&#8217;s common stock outstanding immediately prior to the closing of a Qualified Financing or Qualified Event, as applicable (assuming full conversion or exercise of all convertible and exercisable securities of PodcastOne then outstanding, subject to certain exceptions), and (ii) <ix:nonFraction id="c113575266" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentConvertiblePercentOfOfferingPrice" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">70</ix:nonFraction>% of the offering price of the shares (or whole units, as applicable) in the Qualified Financing or <ix:nonFraction id="c113575267" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentConvertiblePercentageOfListingPrice" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">70</ix:nonFraction>% of the initial listing price of the shares on a national securities exchange in the Qualified Event, as applicable. Each holder of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (other than the Company) could have&#160;at such holder&#8217;s option require PodcastOne to redeem up to <ix:nonFraction id="c113575269" contextRef="d_2022-07-15_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentageOfPrincipalAmountRedeemed" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">45</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of such holder&#8217;s <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (together with accrued interest thereon, but excluding the OID), in aggregate up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575271" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentRedemptionAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3,000,000</ix:nonFraction> for all of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (other than those held by the Company), immediately prior to the completion of a Qualified Financing or a Qualified Event, as applicable, with such redemption to have been made pro rata to the redeeming holders of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (the &#8220;Optional Redemption&#8221;).</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company also agreed (i) <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> to effect a Qualified Financing or a Qualified Event, as applicable, unless immediately following such event the Company owns <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> less than <ix:nonFraction id="c113575276" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentMaximumPercentageOfEquityOwnable" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">66</ix:nonFraction>% of PodcastOne&#8217;s equity, unless in either case otherwise permitted by the written consent of the holders of the majority of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (excluding the Company) (the &#8220;Majority Noteholders&#8221;) and the senior lender, as applicable, (ii) that until a Qualified Financing or a Qualified Event, as applicable, is consummated, the Company guaranteed the repayment of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes when due (other than the Bridge Notes issued to LiveOne) and any interest or other fees due thereunder, and (iii) that if PodcastOne&#160;had&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em> consummated a Qualified Financing or a Qualified Event, as applicable, by <em style="font: inherit;"> February 15, 2023, </em><em style="font: inherit;"> March 15, 2023 </em>or <em style="font: inherit;"> April 15, 2023, </em>unless in either case permitted by the written consent of the Majority Noteholders, PodcastOne was required to redeem $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575280" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentPeriodicRedemption" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">1,000,000</ix:nonFraction> of the then outstanding <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (other than the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes issued to the Company) by the <em style="font: inherit;">tenth</em> calendar day of each month immediately following such respective date, up to an aggregate redemption of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575284" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentRedemptionAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3,000,000</ix:nonFraction> over the course of such <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months, each of which was to be distributed to the holders of the Bridge Notes (other than the Company) on a prorated basis (the &#8220;Early Redemption&#8221;).</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">PodcastOne&#160;further agreed to register the shares of its common stock issuable upon conversion of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes and exercise of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Warrants in connection with a Qualified Financing or a Qualified Event. If PodcastOne&#160;did&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em> file such registration statement on or prior to <em style="font: inherit;"> April 15, 2023, </em>PodcastOne was&#160;required to prepay $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575289" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_CounterpartyNameAxis-OtherNoteHoldersMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentCosts" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">1,000,000</ix:nonFraction> of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes pro rata to the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes holders (other than the Company), and if PodcastOne did&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em> file such registration statement on or prior to <em style="font: inherit;"> July 15, 2023, </em>PodcastOne was required to prepay $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575293" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_CounterpartyNameAxis-RegStRedemptionMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentCosts" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2,000,000</ix:nonFraction> of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes pro rata to the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes holders (other than the Company) (the &#8220;Reg St Redemption&#8221;). PodcastOne was&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#160;required to redeem or repay more than a total of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575297" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentCosts" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3,000,000</ix:nonFraction> of the principal amount of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes as a result of the Optional Redemption, the Early Redemption and/or the Reg St Redemption. As a result of <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> completing the Qualified Event, as of <em style="font: inherit;"> April 15, 2023, </em>PodcastOne&#160;purchased $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575300" contextRef="i_2023-04-15_ConsolidationItemsAxis-IntersegmentEliminationMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:BridgeLoan" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">3.0</ix:nonFraction> million (excluding the OID) worth of <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes which have been eliminated in the consolidation presentation, but otherwise remain issued and outstanding.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> September 8,&#160;</em><em style="font: inherit;">2023,</em> PodcastOne completed a Qualified Event (its spin out from the Company to become a standard publicly trading company (the &#8220;Spin-Out&#8221;)) as a result of its direct listing on The NASDAQ Capital Market on such date (the "Direct Listing"). In connection with such completed Qualified Event, all of the remaining <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes (including interest thereunder) in the aggregate amount of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575304" contextRef="d_2023-09-08_2023-09-08_ConversionOfStockByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfDebtUponCompletingAQualifiedEventMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-4">7.02</ix:nonFraction> million converted into approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c113575305" contextRef="d_2023-09-08_2023-09-08_ConversionOfStockByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfDebtUponCompletingAQualifiedEventMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2,341,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of PodcastOne&#8217;s common stock.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b><i>Warrants</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Warrants were classified as liabilities as they represent an obligation to deliver a variable number of shares of common stock in the future and are therefore required to be initially and subsequently measured at fair value each reporting period. The Company recorded a warrant liability in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575307" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-Pc1NoteWarrantsMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.7</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million (and reduced the proceeds allocated to the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes accordingly). The fair value of the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Warrant liability is remeasured each reporting period using a Black Scholes model, and the change in fair value is recorded as an adjustment to the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Warrant liability with the unrealized gains or losses reflected in other income (expense). On <em style="font: inherit;"> September 8, 2023, </em>as a result of the Direct Listing and PodcastOne's&#160;shares of common stock becoming publicly traded,&#160;the warrant liability was reclassified to equity as the number and exercise price of the warrants was settled at <ix:nonFraction id="c113575311" contextRef="i_2023-09-08_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-Pc1NoteWarrantsMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3,114,000</ix:nonFraction> warrants with an exercise price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575312" contextRef="i_2023-09-08_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-Pc1NoteWarrantsMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3.00</ix:nonFraction> per warrant per the warrant agreement.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b><i>Redemption Features</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company determined that the redemption features associated with the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Bridge Loan meet the accounting definition of an embedded derivative that must be separated from the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Bridge Loan and initially and subsequently be reported as a liability (&#8220;the Redemption Liability&#8221;) and measured at fair value. The fair value of the Redemption Liability was determined using a Monte Carlo simulation model using <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> scenarios (<em style="font: inherit;">1</em>) redemption prior to the initial maturity date (<ix:nonFraction id="c113575330" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-Pc1NoteWarrantsMember_DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodAxis-RedeemedPriorToInitialMaturityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:WarrantAndRightsOutstandingMonteCarloSimulationWeights" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">65</ix:nonFraction>% weighted), (<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) redemption at the initial maturity date (<ix:nonFraction id="c113575332" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-Pc1NoteWarrantsMember_DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodAxis-RedemptionAtInitialMaturityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:WarrantAndRightsOutstandingMonteCarloSimulationWeights" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25</ix:nonFraction>% weighted) and (<em style="font: inherit;">3</em>) redemption after the initial maturity date (<ix:nonFraction id="c113575334" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis-Pc1NoteWarrantsMember_DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodAxis-RedemptionAfterTheInitialMaturityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:WarrantAndRightsOutstandingMonteCarloSimulationWeights" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">10</ix:nonFraction>% weighted).</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The fair value of the Redemption Liability was <ix:nonFraction id="c113575337" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability" scale="6" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">none</ix:nonFraction> at <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024 </em>and was eliminated as the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes were converted into PodcastOne's common stock, and therefore the derivative component was cancelled.&#160;The $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575339" contextRef="d_2023-10-01_2024-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeasuredOnRecurringBasisChangeInUnrealizedGainLoss" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5" sign="-">0.2</ix:nonFraction> million change in the fair value of the Redemption Liability derivative as of <em style="font: inherit;"> September 8, 2023 </em>was&#160;recorded as an unrealized loss and included in&#160;other income&#160;for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The fair value of the Redemption Liability of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575340" contextRef="i_2022-07-15_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.1</ix:nonFraction> million at <em style="font: inherit;"> July 15, 2022 </em>was recorded as a derivative liability and included in other liabilities in the consolidated balance sheet. The fair value of the Redemption Liability at <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2023&#160;</em>was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c113575341" contextRef="i_2023-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million. The $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575342" contextRef="d_2022-07-16_2023-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeasuredOnRecurringBasisChangeInUnrealizedGainLoss" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.1</ix:nonFraction> million change in the fair value of the Redemption Liability derivative is recorded as an unrealized gain and included in other income in the accompanying consolidated statements of operations for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2023.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The resulting discount from the OID, underwriting fees, <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Warrants, and embedded Redemption Liability derivative of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575344" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">2.8</ix:nonFraction> million is being amortized to interest expense through <em style="font: inherit;"> July 15, 2023, </em>the expected term of the Bridge Loan, using the effective interest method. Interest expense resulting from the amortization of the discount for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024</em>&#160; and <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em> was $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575346" contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.1</ix:nonFraction> million and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c113575347" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2023-03-31_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-RedemptionLiabilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.7</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Interest expense with respect to the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024</em>&#160;and <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em> was $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575350" contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.2</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575351" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2023-03-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-Pc1NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.4</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively. There are <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> restrictive operational covenants associated with the <em style="font: inherit;">PC1</em> Notes.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">10</em> </b>&#8212;<b> Senior Secured Revolving Line of Credit</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> June 2, 2021, </em>the Company entered into a Business Loan Agreement with East West Bank (the &#8220;Senior Lender&#8221;), which provided&#160;for a revolving credit facility collateralized by all the assets of the Company and its subsidiaries. In connection with the Business Loan Agreement, the Company entered into a Promissory Note with the Senior Lender and established the revolving line of credit in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575385" contextRef="i_2021-06-02_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">7.0</ix:nonFraction> million (the &#8220;Revolving Credit Facility&#8221;), maturing on <em style="font: inherit;"> June 2, 2023.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> July 2022, </em>the Company extended the maturity date of its revolving credit facility to <em style="font: inherit;"> June 2024 </em>and its variable interest rate was increased to <ix:nonFraction id="c113575386" contextRef="i_2022-07-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">2.5</ix:nonFraction>%. The Revolving Credit Facility bears interest at a variable rate equal to the Wall Street Journal <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575403"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c113575404">Prime Rate</span></span>, plus <ix:nonFraction id="c113575387" contextRef="d_2022-07-31_2022-07-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">2.5</ix:nonFraction>%. The interest rate for the period ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024</em> was <ix:nonFraction id="c113575388" contextRef="i_2022-07-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateAtPeriodEnd" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">11.00</ix:nonFraction>%.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> September 8, 2023 </em>and effective as of <em style="font: inherit;"> August 22, 2023, </em>the Company entered into a new Business Loan Agreement (the &#8220;New Business Loan Agreement&#8221;) with the Senior Lender, to convert the Company&#8217;s&#160;revolving credit facility with the Senior Lender into an assets backed loan credit facility with the Senior Lender, which shall continue to be collateralized by a <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> lien on all of the assets of the Company and its subsidiaries (the &#8220;ABL Credit Facility&#8221;). The New Business Loan Agreement provides the Company with borrowing capacity of up to the Borrowing Base (as defined in the Business Loan Agreement). Pursuant to the New Business Loan Agreement, the requirement that the Company and its related entities shall at all times maintain a certain minimum deposit with the Senior Lender was reduced from $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575390" contextRef="i_2023-07-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentCovenantDepositsHeld" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">8,000,000</ix:nonFraction> to $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575391" contextRef="i_2023-09-08_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="lvo:DebtInstrumentCovenantDepositsHeld" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">5,000,000</ix:nonFraction>.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 27pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt; text-indent: 27pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> May 31, 2024 </em>the Company was granted an extension of <em style="font: inherit;">90</em> days on the maturity date, therefore the Revolving Credit Facility will mature in <em style="font: inherit;"> September 2024, </em>see Note <em style="font: inherit;">20.</em>&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">Borrowings under the ABL Credit Facility are subject to certain covenants as set forth in the New Business Loan Agreement and bear interest at a rate equal to the prime rate plus <ix:nonFraction id="c113575394" contextRef="d_2023-09-08_2023-09-08_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">2.50</ix:nonFraction>%, provided that it shall <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> be less than <ix:nonFraction id="c113575396" contextRef="i_2023-09-08_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateAtPeriodEnd" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">7.00</ix:nonFraction>%. The Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>prepay at any time without penalty all or a portion of the amount owed to the Senior Lender. The Business Loan Agreement includes various financial and other covenants with which the Company has to comply in order to maintain borrowing availability, including maintaining required minimum liquidity amount and Borrowing Base capacity.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 36pt;">In connection with the New Business Loan Agreement, the Company&#8217;s current Promissory Note, dated as of <em style="font: inherit;"> June 2, 2021, </em>issued to the Senior Lender in the principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575397" contextRef="i_2021-06-02_DebtInstrumentAxis-PromissoryNoteMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">7,000,000</ix:nonFraction> (the &#8220;Promissory Note&#8221;) continues in effect except as modified by the New Business Loan Agreement and the Change in Terms Agreement, dated as of <em style="font: inherit;"> August 22, 2023, </em>entered into by the Company and the Senior Lender in connection with the New Business Loan Agreement.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The principal balance under the ABL&#160;Credit Facility as of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em> was $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575399" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCredit" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">7.0</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively.&#160;The Company recorded interest expense of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575400" contextRef="d_2023-04-01_2024-03-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.6</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575401" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2023-03-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.6</ix:nonFraction> million for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>, respectively. The Company was in compliance with all debt covenants associated with the ABL Credit Facility as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024</em>.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b>&#160;<b><em style="font: inherit;">11</em></b>&#160;&#8212;<b> Unsecured Convertible Notes</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2022,&#160;</em>the Company had outstanding <ix:nonFraction id="c113575414" contextRef="i_2022-03-31_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">8.5</ix:nonFraction>% unsecured convertible notes payable (the &#8220;Trinad Notes&#8221;) issued to Trinad Capital Master Fund Ltd. (&#8220;Trinad Capital&#8221;), a fund controlled by Mr. Ellin, the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer, Chairman, director and principal stockholder, as discussed below. The Trinad Notes were convertible into shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock at a fixed conversion price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575415" contextRef="i_2022-03-31_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3.00</ix:nonFraction> per share.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> Trinad Note was issued on <em style="font: inherit;"> February 21, 2017, </em>to convert aggregate principal and interest of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575417" contextRef="d_2017-02-21_2017-02-21_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfOriginalTrinidadLoanMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3.6</ix:nonFraction> million under the <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> senior promissory note and <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> senior promissory note with Trinad Capital previously issued on <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2014 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> April 8, 2015, </em>respectively. The <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> Trinad Note was due on <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2018 </em>and was extended to <em style="font: inherit;"> May 31, 2023 (</em>as discussed below).</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Between <em style="font: inherit;"> October 27, 2017 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 18, 2017, </em>the Company issued <em style="font: inherit;">six</em> unsecured convertible notes payable to Trinad Capital for aggregate total principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575422" contextRef="i_2017-12-18_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.1</ix:nonFraction> million. The notes were due on various dates through <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2018 </em>and were extended to <em style="font: inherit;"> May 31, 2023 (</em>as discussed below). As of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2023 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2022,</em> $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575424" contextRef="i_2023-03-31_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.3</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575425" contextRef="i_2022-03-31_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:InterestPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.3</ix:nonFraction> million of accrued interest was included in the principal balance, respectively.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> August 11, 2021, </em>the Company entered into an Amendment of Notes Agreement (the &#8220;Amendment Agreement&#8221;) with Trinad Capital pursuant to which the maturity date of all of the Trinad Notes was extended to <em style="font: inherit;"> May 31, 2023, </em>and in consideration of such extension, the Company issued to Trinad Capital&#160;<ix:nonFraction id="c113575426" contextRef="d_2021-08-11_2021-08-11_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-AmendmentAgreementMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">33,654</ix:nonFraction>&#160;shares of its common stock. The Company evaluated the Amendment Agreement and the amendment was required to be accounted for as an extinguishment under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">470</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">50,</em>&#160;Debt &#8211; Modifications and Extinguishment.&#160;As a result, the Company determined that the amendment should be accounted for as an extinguishment and we recorded the amended debt instrument at fair value which included the consideration in common stock transferred. The resulting loss on extinguishment recorded of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575429" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2023-03-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-AmendmentAgreementMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5" sign="-">4.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million is included in loss on extinguishment of debt in the accompanying consolidated statement of operations for the year ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2023.&#160;</em>In addition, the Company recorded a $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575430" contextRef="d_2022-04-01_2023-03-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-AmendmentAgreementMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-ConvertibleDebtMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TrinadCapitalMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalConvertibleDebtWithConversionFeature" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">4.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million benefit to additional paid in capital as a result of the excess of the deemed fair value of the Trinad Notes over the principal and accrued interest outstanding at the time of extinguishment.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">13</em> </b>&#8212;<b> Leases</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> December 22, 2020, </em>the Company acquired CPS which included the assumption of an operating lease for a <ix:nonFraction id="c113575485" contextRef="i_2020-12-22_RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationDescriptionOfPropertyAxis-AddisonIllinoisManufacturingFacilityMember" unitRef="SquareFoot" name="us-gaap:AreaOfRealEstateProperty" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">55,120</ix:nonFraction> square foot light manufacturing facility located in Addison Illinois, expiring <em style="font: inherit;"> June&#160;</em><em style="font: inherit;">30,</em> <em style="font: inherit;">2024.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company leases several office locations with lease terms that are less than <em style="font: inherit;">12</em> months or are on month to month terms. Rent expense is recognized over the term of the lease on a straight-line basis.    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Options &#8211; the lease term is the minimum noncancelable period of the lease.    <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024</em>, the Company is obligated under agreements with Content Providers and other contractual obligations to make guaranteed payments as follows: $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575567" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_OtherCommitmentsAxis-AgreementsWithContentProvidersMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitmentDueInNextTwelveMonths" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">6.6</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575568" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_OtherCommitmentsAxis-AgreementsWithContentProvidersMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitmentDueInSecondYear" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.6</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575569" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_OtherCommitmentsAxis-AgreementsWithContentProvidersMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitmentDueInThirdYear" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.5</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575570" contextRef="i_2024-03-31_OtherCommitmentsAxis-AgreementsWithContentProvidersMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitmentDueInFourthYear" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.5</ix:nonFraction> million&#160;for the fiscal year ending <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2025, </em><em style="font: inherit;">2026,</em> <em style="font: inherit;">2027</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">2028,</em> respectively.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On a quarterly basis, the Company records the greater of the cumulative actual content acquisition costs incurred or the cumulative minimum guarantee based on forecasted usage for the minimum guarantee period. The minimum guarantee period of time is the period that the minimum guarantee relates to, as specified in each agreement, which <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be annual or a longer period. The cumulative minimum guarantee, based on forecasted usage, considers factors such as listening hours, revenue, members, and other terms of each agreement that impact the Company&#8217;s expected attainment or recoupment of the minimum guarantees based on the relative attribution method.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Several of the Company&#8217;s content acquisition agreements also include provisions related to the royalty payments and structures of those agreements relative to other content licensing arrangements, which, if triggered, could cause the Company&#8217;s payments under those agreements to escalate, which included payments to be made in common stock. In addition, record labels, publishers and performing rights organizations with whom the Company has entered into direct license agreements have the right to audit the Company&#8217;s content acquisition payments, and any such audit could result in disputes over whether the Company has paid the proper content acquisition costs. However, as of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2024</em>, the Company does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> believe it is probable that these provisions of its agreements discussed above will, individually or in the aggregate, have a material adverse effect on its business, financial position, results of operations or cash flows.</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Legal Proceedings</span></i>&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> April 10, 2018, </em>Joseph Schnaier, Danco Enterprises, LLC (an entity solely owned by Mr. Schnaier, &#8220;Danco&#8221;), Wantmcs Holdings, LLC (Mr. Schnaier is the managing member) and Wantickets (Mr. Schnaier is the&#160;<ix:nonFraction id="c113575593" contextRef="i_2018-04-10_LegalEntityAxis-DancoEnterprisesLlcMember_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-WanticketsMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">90</ix:nonFraction>% beneficial owner) filed a complaint in the Supreme Court of the State of New York, County of New York against the Company, LiveXLive Tickets, Inc. (&#8220;LXL Tickets&#8221;), Robert S. Ellin and certain other defendants. Plaintiffs subsequently voluntarily dismissed all claims against the other defendants. The complaint alleged multiple causes of action arising out of Schnaier&#8217;s investment (through Danco) into the Company in <em style="font: inherit;">2016,</em> LXL Tickets&#8217; purchase of certain operating assets of Wantickets pursuant to the Asset Purchase Agreement, dated as of <em style="font: inherit;"> May 5, 2017 (</em>the "APA"), and Mr. Schnaier&#8217;s employment with LXL Tickets. The Company&#160;denied&#160;plaintiffs&#8217; claims. The Company believed&#160;that the complaint was an intentional act by the plaintiffs to publicly tarnish the Company&#8217;s and its senior management&#8217;s reputations through the public domain in an effort to obtain by threat of litigation certain results for Mr. Schnaier&#8217;s self-serving and improper purposes. The Company&#160;vigorously defended&#160;this lawsuit and believed&#160;that the allegations are without merit and that it has strong defenses. On <em style="font: inherit;"> June 26, 2018, </em>the Company and LXL Tickets, filed counterclaims against the plaintiffs for breach of contract (including under the APA), fraudulent inducement, and other causes of action, seeking injunctive relief, damages, attorneys&#8217; fees and expenses and such other relief as the court <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>award.&#160;As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2022, </em>all of plaintiffs&#8217; claims were dismissed or addressed by the parties or the court other than plaintiffs&#8217; claims for fraudulent inducement related to payment of Wantickets&#8217; audit costs, breach of contract based on Mr. Schnaier&#8217;s employment agreement with LXL Tickets, and fraudulent inducement due to plaintiffs alleged inability to sell their shares of Company&#8217;s common stock acquired pursuant to the APA.&#160;The trial was held in late <em style="font: inherit;"> April </em>and early <em style="font: inherit;"> May 2023. </em>In <em style="font: inherit;"> May 2023, </em>the Company achieved a favorable outcome in this lawsuit, as the jury awarded damages to LXL Tickets in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c113575596" contextRef="d_2023-05-01_2023-05-31_LitigationCaseAxis-SchnaierVersusLivexticketsIncMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement" id="c113575597" contextRef="i_2018-11-22_LitigationCaseAxis-SchnaierVersusLivexticketsIncMember" unitRef="Pure" name="lvo:StatutoryInterestRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"
